body: Three customers from the east fields brought the same sweet chemical smell in their hair. They said the crop trial crew had sprayed before sunrise. I washed everyone twice; by noon a county van had blocked the road.
title: Tuesday, after opening
gloss: A hairdresser records matching residue on field workers before a road closure.
rival_reading: The matching smell and road closure could mark exposure discovered during an emergency response rather than a farm program that caused it.

body:
I kept the book open so they could see when the last customer had come in. The woman asked for the names instead of the times.

She did not take the whole book. She tore out two pages and left the small notes about hair color and the money owed. One customer had asked me to call his wife. I still have her number, but I cannot remember which page it was on.

We swept after they left. A curl of paper caught under the chair and I put it here in case the customer comes back to pay.
title: Appointments crossed out
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
